mddbUrl.title: MDDB Base URL
mddbUrl.description: Base URL of the MDDB instance. Without trailing slash.

apiKey.title: API Key (Bearer Token)
apiKey.description: Bearer token, typically starting with 'vk_'. Leave empty for unauthenticated MDDB instances.

keyField.title: Primary Key Field
keyField.description: Record field name used as MDDB document key. If the field is missing or null on a record, a SHA-1 hash of the record is used instead.

language.title: Document Language
language.description: ISO locale code stored on every document.

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Records buffered before flushing to MDDB.

verifySsl.title: Verify TLS Certificate
verifySsl.description: Disable only for self-signed dev instances.
